title: Shadows over Innistrad Remastered: card flavor text

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A region of Innistrad where hunters go on expeditions and devils make mischief.

entities.name: Devilthorn Lodge
entities.description: A lodge of hunters who rely on the cleverness of foxes to counteract devils on expeditions through Ashmouth.

entities.name: Order of Saint Traft
entities.description: An order that found new strength with Sigarda's support.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: A figure whose support gave the Order of Saint Traft new strength.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A companion of Alena who grew brambles to make a barricade around their camp.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region of Innistrad, home of the trapper Alena.

events.summary: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength through Sigarda's support.
events.quote: The Order of Saint Traft found new strength with Sigarda's support.

events.summary: Alena recalls that Halana grew a bramble barricade around their camp to keep wolves out, a mistake that nearly cost them dearly.
events.quote: Halana grew brambles to create a barricade around our camp, hoping that it would keep the wolves out.
